name: Get health
docs: Checks service health. No authentication. Returns status and host information.

name: Get alive message
docs: Checks that the service is alive and returns a random monkey message.

name: Get device information
docs: Returns the cogmoteGO instance ID, host, operating system and build metadata.

name: List broadcast endpoints
docs: Lists all in-memory broadcast endpoint names.

name: Create broadcast endpoint
docs: Creates an in-memory broadcast endpoint. The name must be unique.

name: Publish default broadcast data
docs: Publishes an arbitrary raw payload to the built-in default endpoint.

name: Get latest default broadcast data
tests: test("returns data or no history", () => expect([200, 404]).to.include(res.status));
docs: Returns the latest payload from the default endpoint as application/json.

name: Subscribe default broadcast SSE
docs: Opens a Server-Sent Events stream and replays history. Manual request: it remains open until cancelled.

name: Publish named broadcast data
docs: Publishes an arbitrary raw payload to a named endpoint. Create it first.

name: Get latest named broadcast data
tests: test("returns data or not found", () => expect([200, 404]).to.include(res.status));
docs: Returns the latest payload for a named broadcast endpoint.

name: Subscribe named broadcast SSE
docs: Opens a Server-Sent Events stream for a named endpoint. Manual request: it remains open until cancelled.

name: Delete named broadcast endpoint
docs: Deletes a named in-memory broadcast endpoint and its history.

name: Stream mock broadcast data
docs: Streams generated mock trial data. Manual long-running request.

name: Get latest mock broadcast data
docs: Waits for and returns the latest generated mock trial data; may return 408 on timeout.

name: List command proxies
docs: Lists active ZeroMQ REQ command proxies.

name: Create command proxy
docs: Creates a ZeroMQ REQ proxy and performs a handshake with the configured endpoint. Requires a compatible local worker.

name: Send command through proxy
docs: Sends an arbitrary raw command payload through an active ZeroMQ proxy and returns the worker response.

name: Delete command proxy
docs: Closes and removes one command proxy.

name: Delete all command proxies
docs: Closes and removes all active command proxies.

name: List experiments
docs: Lists all registered experiment records.

name: Register local experiment
docs: Registers a local experiment. On success, stores its generated ID as experimentId.

name: Delete all experiments
docs: Deletes every experiment record. This is destructive and should only be run intentionally.

name: Get experiment by ID
docs: Gets a registered experiment by experimentId.

name: Update experiment
docs: Replaces the experiment metadata for experimentId.

name: Delete experiment
docs: Deletes one experiment record.

name: Initialize Git experiment
docs: Clones and initializes a registered experiment whose type is git.

name: Update Git experiment
docs: Pulls updates for an initialized Git experiment.

name: Switch Git experiment branch
docs: Switches an initialized Git experiment to gitBranch.

name: Initialize archive experiment
docs: Uploads a ZIP in multipart field file and initializes an archive experiment. Select a local ZIP file in Bruno before sending.

name: Update archive experiment
docs: Uploads a ZIP in multipart field file and replaces an archive experiment. Select a local ZIP file in Bruno before sending.

name: Start experiment
docs: Starts the registered experiment process. This executes commands from the experiment record.

name: Start experiment command by nickname
docs: Intended to start one named command. Current server wiring calls StartExperimentHandler and ignores nickname; use with caution until the route is fixed.

name: Stop experiment
docs: Kills the currently running experiment process.

name: Get experiment data file
docs: Reads a file exposed from registered experiment data directories. filepath may contain path segments.

name: Get experiment status
docs: Returns the global in-memory experiment running status.

name: Update experiment status
docs: Partially updates id and/or is_running in the global experiment status.

name: Get OBS status
docs: Returns OBS version and streaming state. Call Initialize OBS client first.

name: Start OBS application
docs: Starts or attaches to the local OBS application.

name: Stop OBS application
docs: Stops the tracked local OBS process.

name: Initialize OBS client
docs: Connects to local OBS WebSocket, prepares the configured scene and text source.

name: Start OBS streaming
docs: Starts streaming through the initialized OBS client.

name: Stop OBS streaming
docs: Stops streaming through the initialized OBS client.

name: Update OBS overlay data
docs: Updates the configured OBS text source with experiment overlay data.

name: Get email configuration
docs: Returns non-secret SMTP configuration and whether credentials are available.

name: Get email recipients
docs: Lists configured email recipients.

name: Add email recipient
docs: Adds a recipient and persists the configuration. Uses a synthetic example address.

name: Delete email recipient
docs: Removes a recipient and persists the configuration.

name: Send test email
docs: Sends a test message using configured SMTP credentials and recipients.

name: Send email
docs: Sends an HTML email. Attachment and embed content fields are base64 strings because the Go API uses []byte.

name: Get current backup task
docs: Returns the latest in-memory backup task. Internal listener only; 404 before any task exists.

name: Create backup task
docs: Creates an asynchronous backup task on the loopback-only internal API. Root IDs must already be configured; existing destination entries are not overwritten.
